## Lisbon Spring Trip Plan: 4 Days, 2 Adults

A balanced Lisbon itinerary for **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13** with museums, walkable neighborhoods, seafood, and one easy coastal reset. Budget target is kept near **€900 total excluding flights** by favoring central transit, casual lunches, and one higher-value museum day.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Cost Estimate

### Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and Alfama Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and do a gentle walk through **Baixa** and **Rossio**; stop at **Santa Justa area** and the **Rua Augusta Arch**.
- Afternoon: Explore **Chiado** and **Alfama** on foot, with time for viewpoints like **Miradouro de Santa Luzia**.
- Dinner: Seafood dinner in Alfama or Baixa; choose grilled fish, clams, or seafood rice.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€170**
  - Lodging: €110
  - Food & drinks: €45
  - Local transport: €15
  - Sightseeing: €0

### Day 2: Museums and Historic Center
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit the **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** or **National Museum of Ancient Art**.
- Afternoon: Slow walk through **Príncipe Real** and **Bairro Alto**; add a café stop and a second museum if energy is good.
- Dinner: Casual seafood spot with sardines, octopus, or cod dishes.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€210**
  - Lodging: €110
  - Food & drinks: €55
  - Local transport: €15
  - Sightseeing: €30

### Day 3: Belém Culture Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- Morning: Head to **Belém** for the **Jerónimos Monastery** and **Belém Tower** area.
- Afternoon: Visit the **MAAT** or **Coach Museum**, then linger by the river for an easy-paced afternoon.
- Dinner: Seafood near the river or back in the center; keep it simple after a full sightseeing day.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€235**
  - Lodging: €110
  - Food & drinks: €55
  - Local transport: €15
  - Sightseeing: €55

### Day 4: Beach or Scenic Viewpoint Reset
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Choose a relaxed half-day at **Cascais** beach promenade or a scenic city viewpoint if weather is cooler.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Morning: Choose a relaxed half-day at **Cascais** beach promenade or a scenic city viewpoint if weather is cooler, Lisbon, Portugal
- Afternoon: Return to Lisbon for a final stroll, souvenir shopping, and a late lunch.
- Dinner: Final seafood meal with a budget-friendly wine pairing.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€180**
  - Lodging: €110
  - Food & drinks: €50
  - Local transport: €20
  - Sightseeing: €0

### Budget Check for the Full Trip
| Item | Estimated Total |
|---|---:|
| Lodging | €440 |
| Food & drinks | €205 |
| Local transport | €65 |
| Museums and entry fees | €85 |
| Buffer / extras | €105 |
| **Trip total** | **€900** |

## Best-Value Daily Plan for Your Interests

- **Museums:** Prioritize **Day 2** and **Day 3** for the strongest museum coverage.
- **Walking:** Lisbon rewards slow walking, so keep neighborhoods grouped by area to reduce transit.
- **Seafood:** Plan seafood dinners on **all four nights**; lunch can be lighter and cheaper.
- **Beach/scenic afternoon:** **Day 4** is the most relaxed choice, with **Cascais** as the easiest beach add-on.

## Spring Packing List for Lisbon

- Light jacket or trench coat
- 2–3 breathable tops
- 2 pairs of comfortable walking shoes
- Compact umbrella
- Light sweater or layer for evenings
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Small day bag or crossbody
- Reusable water bottle
- Smart-casual outfit for nicer dinners
- Portable charger
- Light scarf for windy viewpoints or cooler mornings
